quotes.text: Great boat trip. Captain Ken was great. We have been coming to Lake George village almost every other year but finally experienced the lake and views at a 360 degree angle. Swimming in the middle of the lake with my family and tubing topped it off. Thanks again. Will be back again with family and friends.

Do not hesitate to book! My family and I had an incredible time with Capitan Steve on our boat tour of Lake George. I can not recommend this enough. Lots of laughs and great views along the way. A memorable moment and grateful my family and I were able to experience this. Thank you again!

Amazing experience!!! Jonathan was so accommodating, I called to see if he had a slot for my son and I and he added one at the end of the day for us! He was extremely professional, and super fun! He deliver all that he promises and more! I will definitely be coming back for more!

We had a fabulous day on Lake George. Joe was our Captain and was knowledgeable about the lake and it’s history. He really made sure we had an awesome time. Our 3 children ages 15, 13 and 10 had a blast!
Dave was an amazing tour guide! My kids had a great time on the tube. His knowledge about the lake and the history was great! Can’t wait to use you guys again next year!!
Katy was interesting and professional. She gave our granddaughter a wonderful tubing ride that she really enjoyed. Thanks
